has.
Their <c:ffff00>{{skill_level}}<c> rises more easily.

to these <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c>: <c:ffff00>{{success}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{power}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c>.

{{gold}} +6.
